# Subset Myeloid

```{r}
so <- subset(so_m %>% set_idents("RNA_snn_res.0.1"), 
             ident = c("0", "2", "3", "4", "5"))
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% plot_umap(color_str = "nFeature_RNA") 
```

# Rerun Seurat workflow

```{r}
so <- run_seurat_rna_workflow(so)
```

# Clustering 

```{r}
for (res in seq(0.2, 0.8, 0.1)) {
    so <- FindClusters(so, resolution = res)
}
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}

```

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    dplyr::select(cell, UMAP_1, UMAP_2, all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res."))) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res.")),

                 values_to = "cluster") %>%
```

# Assign clusters

```{r}
cluster_ann_df <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_annotations.xlsx")) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    filter(Subset == "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds") %>% 
    filter(clustering == "RNA_snn_res.0.5") %>% 
    mutate(cluster_ID_name = paste0(cluster, ": ", cluster_ID))

cluster_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)
cluster_grouped_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_grouped %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)

palette_cluster <- cluster_ann_df$color %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name)

cluster_ID_name_ordered <- cluster_ann_df %>% 
    arrange(cluster_ID_grouped) %>% 
    .$cluster_ID_name
```

```{r}
cell_type_metadata <- get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", reduction = NULL) %>%
    mutate(clusters_M = cluster_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.5)]) %>% 
    mutate(clusters_M = factor(clusters_M, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    mutate(general_M_subtypes = cluster_grouped_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.5)]) %>% 
    select(-RNA_snn_res.0.5) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell")
so <- AddMetaData(so, metadata = cell_type_metadata)
```

# Dot plot marker

```{r}
genes <- c(
    "Cd209a", "H2-Ab1", # Monocytic DCs
    "Irf8", "Itgax", "Sirpa", "Flt3", "Xcr1", # DCs
    "Ccr7", "Fscn1", # Migratory DCs
    "Siglech", # pDCs 
    "Mki67", "Stmn1", # Proliferating
    "Wfdc17", # M2a macs
    "Adgre1", "Ccl12", "C1qa", "C1qb", # M1 macs
    "Ly6i", "Ctsk", # unknown mac markers
    "Mmp12", "Arg1", # MDSC
    "Chil3", "Il1b", # Monocyte/Neuts
    "Ace", # Ace-high monocytes
    "S100a9", "S100a8" # Neutrophils
)

dotplot_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = "clusters_M",
                         genes = genes,
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.),
                 names_to = "gene",
                 values_to = "expr") %>%
    mutate(clusters_M = factor(clusters_M, levels = rev(cluster_ID_name_ordered))) %>% 
    mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = genes)) %>% 
    group_by(gene) %>%
    mutate(scaled_expr = as.vector(scale(expr))) %>%
    group_by(clusters_M, gene) %>%
    summarise(mean_scaled_expr = mean(expr), 
              pct_expression = sum(expr > 0) / n()) %>%
    mutate(
        color = palette_cluster[as.character(clusters_M)], 
        name = glue::glue("<i style='color:{color}'>{clusters_M}</i>")
    ) %>% 
    mutate(name = fct_reorder(name, as.integer(clusters_M)))
dotplot_df %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(gene, name) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pct_expression, color = mean_scaled_expr)) + 
    labs(caption = "color is scaled mean expression; size is % cell expressing; cell types not shown in any particular order here") + 
    scale_color_viridis(limits = c(NA, 3) ,oob = scales::squish) + 
    remove_spines() + 
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(color = "black"), 
          axis.title = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "none", 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), 
          axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown())
```

## Box plots with stats

```{r}
group_mouse_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = c("mouse", "hash.ID", "seq", "group"),
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    select(mouse, group, hash.ID, seq) %>% 
    unique()
```

### Proportion of Total Myeloid

```{r}
prop_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = c("mouse", "seq", "general_M_subtypes", "clusters_M"),
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    calculate_proportion(general_M_subtypes, mouse) %>%
    left_join(group_mouse_df, by = "mouse")

prop_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(group, prop) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_point() + 
    labs(y = "Proportion of Myeloid cells", 
         caption = "P-values from t tests") +
    stat_compare_means(
        comparisons = prop_df$group %>% unique() %>% combn(m = 2, simplify = F),
        label = "p.signif",
        method = "t.test"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ general_M_subtypes, scale = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ~ c(0, .[2] * 1.1),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    remove_x_spine() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
    ))
```

### GSEA with ranked list

```{r}
sig_dir <- here("data", "signatures")
mouse_human_genes <- readRDS(here("data", "signatures", "mouse_human_genes.rds")) %>% 
    as_tibble()
jablonski_df <-
    read_tsv(
        file.path(
            sig_dir,
            "m2_sigs",
            "Combined_Jablonski_Alt_Class_Mac.gmt.txt"
        ),
        col_names = FALSE
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(signature = X1, source = X2) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-X759) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.), 
                 names_to = "column", 
                 values_to = "gene") %>% 
    filter(!is.na(gene)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-column) %>% 
    left_join(mouse_human_genes, by = c("gene" = "HGNC.symbol")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(human_gene = gene) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(gene = MGI.symbol) 
jablonski_gs <- jablonski_df %>% 
    drop_na(gene) %>% 
    named_group_split(signature) %>% 
    map(~..1$gene)
```

```{r}
ranked_b2m_KO <- markers_isotype_macs_b2m.vs.wt %>% 
    mutate(signed_pval = ifelse(avg_log2FC > 0, -log10(p_val + 1e-100), log10(p_val + 1e-100))) %>% 
    arrange(desc(signed_pval)) %>% 
    {set_names(.$signed_pval, rownames(.))}
library(liger)
jablonski_gsea_out <-
    run_or_readRDS(file.path(m_dir, "gsea_b2m.v.wt_jablonski.rds"),
                   function() {
                       iterative.bulk.gsea(ranked_b2m_KO,
                                           set.list = jablonski_gs,
                                           power = 0)
                   })
```

## cd40 vs isotype

First, let's check how many cells we have in each group. 

```{r}
so@meta.data %>%
    as_tibble(rownames = "cell") %>%
    group_by(clusters_M, group) %>% 
    count() %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(clusters_M, n, fill = group) + 
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.5) + 
    theme(legend.position = "right") + 
    coord_flip() + 
    scale_y_log10(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(1, 5000))
    
```

Well, we don't have that many DCs, but I think that's enough to make comparisons between CD40 treated DCs in each genotype separately. Worth keeping in mind that pDCs and migratory DCs may suffer here a bit in the WT treated with CD40 agonist. 

```{r}
markers_ctrl_cd40.v.iso_list <- so@meta.data$clusters_M %>%
    unique() %>%
    .[1:14] %>% # remove Ctsk high macs which aren't a big enough group for comparison
    {set_names(., str_sub(str_extract(., "[:digit:]*\\:"), end = -2))} %>%
    imap( ~ {
        run_or_readRDS(file.path(
            m_dir,
            paste0(
                "dge_filterRNA200mito10_subsetM_clust",
                ..2,
                "_Ctrl_CD40.v.iso.rds"
            )
        ),
        function() {
            FindMarkers(
                so %>% set_idents("clusters_M"),
                ident.1 = "Ctrl__CD40 agonist",
                ident.2 = "Ctrl__Isotype",
                group.by = "group",
                subset.ident = ..1
            )
        })
    })
markers_b2mko_cd40.v.iso_list <- so@meta.data$clusters_M %>%
    unique() %>%
    .[1:14] %>% # remove Ctsk high macs which aren't a big enough group for comparison
    {set_names(., str_sub(str_extract(., "[:digit:]*\\:"), end = -2))} %>%
    imap( ~ {
        run_or_readRDS(file.path(
            m_dir,
            paste0(
                "dge_filterRNA200mito10_subsetM_clust",
                ..2,
                "_b2mKO_CD40.v.iso.rds"
            )
        ),
        function() {
            FindMarkers(
                so %>% set_idents("clusters_M"),
                ident.1 = "B2m KO__CD40 agonist",
                ident.2 = "B2m KO__Isotype",
                group.by = "group",
                subset.ident = ..1
            )
        })
    })
```

```{r markers_cd40.v.iso_df}
markers_ctrl_cd40.v.iso_df <- markers_ctrl_cd40.v.iso_list %>% 
    map_dfr(as_tibble, rownames = "gene", .id = "cluster")
markers_b2mko_cd40.v.iso_df <- markers_b2mko_cd40.v.iso_list %>% 
    map_dfr(as_tibble, rownames = "gene", .id = "cluster")
markers_cd40.v.iso_df <- bind_rows(
```

## In macrophages

```{r}
nsig_genes_df <- markers_cd40.v.iso_df %>% 
    filter(cluster %in% c("2", "3", "4", "5", "7", "14")) %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
    mutate(direction = ifelse(abs(avg_log2FC) > 1, "CD40", "isotype")) %>% 
    group_by(cluster, genotype, direction) %>% 
    count()
nsig_genes_df %>% 
    mutate(n = ifelse(direction == "isotype", -n, n)) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(cluster, n, fill = genotype) + 
    geom_col(position = "dodge") + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
    labs(title = "Number of significant genes padj < 0.05 with logFC > 1", 
         subtitle = "CD40 vs iso in each cluster, and each genotype", 
         y = "Number of genes enriched in CD40 (up) or iso (dn)")
```

## In DCs

```{r}
nsig_genes_df <- markers_cd40.v.iso_df %>% 
    filter(cluster %in% c("8", "9", "10")) %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
    mutate(direction = ifelse(abs(avg_log2FC) > 1, "CD40", "isotype")) %>% 
    group_by(cluster, genotype, direction) %>% 
    count()
nsig_genes_df %>% 
    mutate(n = ifelse(direction == "isotype", -n, n)) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(cluster, n, fill = genotype) + 
    geom_col(position = "dodge") + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
    labs(title = "Number of significant genes padj < 0.05 with logFC > 1", 
         subtitle = "CD40 vs iso in each cluster, and each genotype", 
         y = "Number of genes enriched in CD40 (up) or iso (dn)")
```
